strings.subtitle: — Fayile Halaaqu —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Horo dandaamanno dino. Gannate qulfi fayida.
strings.shred_button: H A L A A Q
strings.ssd_warning: Akeeka! SSD giddo, kana qaadi TRIM sababaanni halaquwa akeekkanno dino. Kana programme HDD qofa.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS woro daata daana (ADS) loosamme dino.
• USN kurbaana qulqullamme dino.
• Haraano nakaali bada wingu sinkirona
  (OneDrive bada woro) tutaamme dino.
strings.status_full: Giddo noo baalcho sufraanni baddalate. Agurro dandaamanno dino — meeshaale sufra qofa la’anno.
strings.status_fast: Uma, gaba bada 4 MB daana baddalate. Hasa’no tutaamme dino, garuni guddurri sababaanni, fayile baalcho agurro dandaamanno dino. Ichchashsha borattora qaadi BAYRO fayida.
strings.status_empty: Fayile mullo tenne, baddala hasiissamme dino. Halaaqamte.
strings.error_permission: Fayile-tti egamanno dino. Woro programme giddo fani no. Cufi bada xa’mi.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kana daana mallatto. Daana halaaqamanno dino — manni fayile hathi.
strings.error_reparse: Kana yannara fayile (OneDrive walu woro). Daata wingu giddo no, diski giddo dino — halaaquwa dino.
strings.error_not_file: Kana fayile dino (foldere walu woro). Fayile horo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Kana fayile woro daana cima no ({n} baalcho). Daana cima manni daana dino — baalcho suu mittu. Kana daanaanni halaaqitikkonne, daata baddalate 32 byte-itti gabamanno, garuni woro daanaanni fani.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayile banamte, simbamte walu sparse. Sufraanni baddala kase daata halaquwa akeekkanno dino, NTFS woro gari hanna sababaanni.

Sifa horo: qini qulfi → Sifa → Guddurri → "Ban" bada/walu "Simba" horo. Sare SHREDDER xa’mi.
